name: clinic-management-css-build
description: CSS minification build tooling for Clinic Management System - cz-css-1004 remediation. Minifies all unminified CSS/SCSS/LESS source assets via PostCSS/cssnano in the Docker multi-stage build pipeline, reducing ECR storage costs and Kubernetes pod startup time. CURRENT FIX BATCH (cz-css-1004): 30 occurrences in font-awesome LESS files - list.less (lines 5,6,7,11,12,13,14,15,17), mixins.less (lines 5,6,7,8,9,10,15,16,17,18,22,23,24,25), path.less (lines 5,6,7,13,14), rotated-flipped.less (line 19), stacked.less (line 5) - all resolved by PostCSS/cssnano minification passes in Docker Stage 1 (css-minify). Includes: style.css, font-awesome.css, bootstrap.css, form-elements.css, grid-view.css, patient-style.css, footer-distributed-with-address-and-phones.css, demo.css, font-awesome LESS files (animated, bordered-pulled, core, fixed-width, larger, list, mixins, path, rotated-flipped, stacked), and font-awesome SCSS files (_animated, _bordered-pulled, _core, _fixed-width, _larger, _list, _mixins, _path, _rotated-flipped, _stacked).
